pages.text: $(thing)Trichoderma$() ($(o)Trichoderma harzianum$()), symbiont.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() all crops.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() soilborne.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 10-35 °C (best 25 °C).
